crossRefs.note: Samuel took a suckling lamb, and offered it for a whole burnt offering to Yahweh. Samuel cried to Yahweh for Israel…
His return was to Ramah, for his house was there; and he judged Israel there; and he built an altar to Yahweh there.
On the next day, the people rose early and built an altar there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings.
For Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; and Judah has multiplied fortified cities; but I will send a fire…
holding a form of godliness, but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul built an altar to Yahweh. This was the first altar that he built to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Then Saul built an altar to the LORD; it was the first time he had built an altar to the LORD.
translations.kjv: And Saul built an altar unto the LORD: the same was the first altar that he built unto the LORD.
translations.asv: And Saul built an altar unto Jehovah: the same was the first altar that he built unto Jehovah.
